top_signals.title: German Workers Protest After VW Slashes Profit Outlook
top_signals.summary: Tens of thousands of workers across Germany plan to stage protests on Monday, seeking protection for jobs and factories. Employees at Volkswagen, which slashed its profit outlook late Friday, as well as Mercedes-Benz, BMW, Audi, Porsche and major suppliers, will take part in demonstrations at more than 280 events nationwide. Bloomberg's Elisabeth Behrmann reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Europe’s Fuel Crisis Spreads From Diesel to Jet Fuel
top_signals.summary: Europe is reeling from a diesel supply crunch, and now another squeeze is looming on the horizon, as jet fuel supply tightens ahead of the final quarter of the year. Per Energy Aspects, the shortfall in jet fuel supply for Europe next quarter could reach 510,000 barrels daily, Reuters reported today, adding that the consultancy sees a jet fuel surplus of 18,000 barrels daily in the United States and a larger 419,000-bpd surplus in the Asia-Pacific.
